data.exact_reserve_text: Claims incurred, net of reinsurance, totalled GBP 448.0 million during the calendar year (2015: GBP 308.2 million). This includes an amount of GBP 33.1 million in respect of increases to reserves on 2014 and prior underwriting years (2015: GBP 33.6 million in respect of reserve releases from 2013 and prior underwriting years).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Announcement of revised Ogden discount rate led to increases in reserves, particularly affecting motor reinsurance and general liability and materially impacting the 2014 closed year result.
Higher incidence of smaller-scale natural catastrophes in 2016 increased claims experience and absorbed losses that did not trigger reinsurance recoveries, constraining results.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2016 were GBP 1,157.9m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle for underwriting years 2014 and earlier indicates a net adverse prior-year re-estimation (strengthening) of c. GBP 54.8m (4.7% of opening gross reserves). Management attributes the deterioration primarily to the post-year-end Ogden discount rate announcement (impacting bodily injury liabilities, particularly motor and general liability) and a higher incidence of smaller-scale natural catastrophe losses during 2016. The syndicate also revised aspects of its DAC accounting during the year which affected comparatives. The report also separately cites a figure of GBP 33.1m increase in reserves on 2014 and prior years in narrative P&L commentary (this appears as a claims-incurred prior-year item), while the triangle-based gross re-estimate yields a larger gross strengthening.
raw_causal_phrases: The Lord Chancellor's Ogden rate announcement, both in terms of timing and severity, has overshadowed our 2016 results.
The resultant increases in reserves within our motor reinsurance and general liability classes have significantly eroded profits this year
increased prevalence of global natural disasters
change to the application of our accounting policy on the treatment of Deferred Acquisition Costs
This includes an amount of GBP 33.1 million in respect of increases to reserves on 2014 and prior underwriting years
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development gross figure was calculated from the gross claims development table (triangle) on page 34 by summing the changes in current estimates vs prior diagonal for underwriting years 2014 and earlier. The narrative and P&L reference a GBP 33.1m figure relating to increases on 2014 and prior years but that appears in claims-incurred (P&L) wording; the triangle-based gross re-estimate is c. GBP 54.8m. 2010 & prior column in the triangle is an aggregate and was excluded per instructions. Ogden announcement occurred post-year-end (Feb 2017) but the syndicate adjusted reserves accordingly; this timing may explain differences between narrative P&L phrasing and triangle-based calculation.
